## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh` passes locally (forbidden patterns + `swift build` + `swift test`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (see AGENTS.md)
- [ ] User-visible change noted in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] No new dependency, listening socket, hard-coded URL, or write to Messages data
- [ ] No real phone numbers, email handles, chat guids, Telegram ids, tokens or message text in code, fixtures or this description
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, commands or config keys changed (README, docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md, SPEC.md)
